title: intent: refactor ExpressFlow to use typestates
description: Update the Express mode state machine to use DiscoverySession and ValidatedSession. Enforce type-safe transitions.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL manage user input via type-safe session states.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL attempt to transition to ValidatedSession.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT permit the user to proceed to Planning

postconditions: ExpressFlow uses try_gate() for phase progression
invariants: UI state is always in sync with the session type

title: intent: refactor GuidedFlow to use typestates
description: Update the Guided mode state machine to use DiscoverySession. Ensure consistency with Express mode gating.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain consistent phase gating across all input modes.

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the final question is answered
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL calculate the quality report.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT show the 'Continue' button

postconditions: GuidedFlow transitions to Planning via ValidatedSession
invariants: The session ID is preserved across mode switches

title: intent: remove legacy ImproverQualityReport
description: Delete the ImproverQualityReport type and all its usages. Replace with the unified domain::QualityReport.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL have zero redundant quality types.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL verify zero references to legacy report types.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT be considered clean

invariants: All suggestions are still correctly mapped to issues
